# Third-party files served locally instead of from cdn.jsdelivr.net (09/11/2026).
# Taken with `npm pack <package>@<version>` at the versions the layouts pinned;
# jsdelivr's /npm/ paths serve those same package files, byte for byte.
# All five packages are MIT-licensed; each directory keeps its LICENSE.
#
# The .min files end in a sourceMappingURL comment and the .map files are not here.
# A browser fetches a .map only with developer tools open, so it costs a 404 in the
# console and nothing else. Left as shipped so the bytes stay checkable against the CDN.
#
# sha256  local path  <-  the URL it replaces
